panels.title: The light becomes a burning vallam, far left
beats: Start = last frame of approved s23-sh01: same bow view, Antony at the rail right of the stem post, leaning left.

2–5.5 s a long, low vallam (no raised ends, no sail) burning, smoke leaning right; he straightens, grips the rail.
5.5–8 s he leans in again, breathing faster. Deep night; no people seen on the boat.
